### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode
Desmond Ferreira-Langston (phone 4805550318, DOB 1977-11-03, ZIP 85296, last4 3519) made a 900 USD online payment this morning and wants "the agent to work out how much of this morning's payment can go to that tire plan and set it up", the 18-month plan on the March tires + road hazard for the Highlander; he will confirm the direction himself. Passive persona: identifiers on request; "if the agent tells you that something else on the account has to be taken care of first, you say that is fine … go ahead with whatever the account rules call for"; accepts a figure under 900 after one "why"; runs the handed-over tool with the given values.

### 2. Act / wait / refuse
Act now. ### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Returned-fee courtesy credit on b03830c8 (agent write).** Conditions: allowance 1 (Card Preferred), 0 courtesy credits in 12 months, payment replaced by due date, no reversal → qualifies. Baseline whole fee → **fall-back 41.00**. Factors: return-history share — two returned payment fees in 12 months (07-29, 10-20), opened 42 whole months ago ≥ 36 → **0.55**; card use 449.98+189.40+1025.72+655.36+264.85+486.30 = 3071.61 with promo plans → **+0.1**; courtesy record — none in 24 months → **+0.1**; road hazard + battery both active and on the card → **+0.1**; size 334.00/41 = 8.15 → [3,10) → **+0.05**; repeat level — fee 41, other fee 07-29 is not fewer than 3 months before 11-10 → 11 outright, share on 30. Share 0.90; credit = 11 + 27 = **38.00**.

**(b) Deferred interest assessed on P6 (agent write).** Baseline: sum of accruals **83.17** (fall-back). Daily rate 29.49/365; stub days 10-11…11-01 = 22.
- Stub accrual: 381.45 × d × 22 = 6.78020 added.
- Returned-payment allocation: most recent returned payment PMT-326101547, allocation 250.00 recorded 10-15 (after the last accrual's closing 10-10) → 250 × d × 22 = 4.44370 added.
- Road hazard refund: 26.60 paid 08-14 (on/before 10-10) → 26.60 × d × 22 = 0.47281 taken off.
- Window reallocation: allocation 300.00 toward the 10-10 statement went to P18 (ends after P6); not from the most recent returned payment; no other plan ended between 10-10 and 11-01 → 300 (≤ 381.45) reallocated; interest 300 × d × 5 (10-28…11-01) = 1.21192 taken off.
Assessed = 83.17 + 6.78020 + 4.44370 − 0.47281 − 1.21192 = 92.70917 → **92.71**.

**(c) Amount directed to P18 (user write).** Minimum still unpaid 84 − (84+300) → 0; fees still owed: returned fee 41.00 − 38.00 = 3.00; deferred interest of P6 (assessment stands) 92.71 → available 900 − 0 − 3.00 − 92.71 = 804.29. Window order: P12 (recorded 414.98) ends 11-28, within 61 days → 804.29 − 414.98 = 389.31 reaches P18. Holds: channel online 0.1 + returned-payment hold (two returns within 6 months: 07-29, 10-20) 0.25 = 0.35; releases: tenure (42 months, two returns in 24 months) 0.4 + relationship (active tire set and alignment plan on the card) 0.2 = 0.6 → held 0.35 × 0.4 = 0.14. Directed = 389.31 × 0.86 = 334.8066, cap 725.72 not binding → **334.81**. Fall-back (baseline only, after the two writes): min(804.29, 725.72) = **725.72**.

### 6. Problem tree
P1 returned-fee courtesy credit → P0; P2 P6 assessment → P0; P1 and P2 independent (no prerequisite sentence in either hub).
- P0 ← P1, **state-derived**: hub sentence "A payment direction is not fixed until the returned payment fee charged for a payment made toward the latest statement, when it meets the returned-payment courtesy conditions, carries its courtesy credit." Records: fee b03830c8 for PMT-326101547 (toward 10-10), no reversal. "returned payment fee courtesy" → "Northgate Returned-Payment Courtesy Schedule…" (rank 1) whose own conditions are met and whose own block posts the credit.
- P0 ← P2, **state-derived**: "A payment direction is not fixed until the deferred interest owed on a plan whose promotional period ended since the latest statement closed stands assessed on the account." Records: P6 expired 11-01 > 10-10, no assessment entry. "deferred interest promotional period ended assess" → "Assessing Deferred Interest When a Crestline Credit Card Promotional Period Ends" (rank 1).
Counter-proof "only direct the payment": the hub says the direction "is not fixed" while either state is unmet, and the baseline's coverage rows read the reversal and the assessment ("the assessment when one stands, or … the accruals"), so a direction alone (available 775.83 before any write) is excluded by visible text.
Closest alternatives excluded: whole 900 ("what is left is the amount available to direct"); P12 or P6 as named plan ("ends last"); direction to P18 without the P12 window deduction (window-order table); holds without releases.
Findability: every factor reached by record words (payment_channel online; returned payment entries; open date; tire set/alignment plan tender; road hazard/battery tender; hazard cancellation refund; allocation of PMT-326102841 to P18; returned-payment allocation of PMT-326101547 to P6). The assessment hub's sentence "on the plan's balance as the allocation, returned-payment and refund rules here correct it" and its scope line pre-announce factor kinds (checked against source in Step 3b).

Blind values: courtesy credit 38.00; assessment 92.71; direction 334.81 (statement_date 2026-10-10, payment PMT-326111079, purchase 2ffe9ac5…).
